differences.what: A module, exam_cv_perfusion, that the General note type includes: its section Perfusion, edema and JVD shows only while Cardiovascular (exam.systems is cardiovascular) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. Cardiovascular is two modules, one for each piece; exam_cv_rhythm is the other.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory section 7 (pieces 6 and 7), default 10

differences.what: Pulses is a grid with a row for each pulse site (lines 19 to 27), recorded for the right and the left (sides), each cell choose-one from the shared list pulse_scale: 0 (added), 1+, 2+, 3+, Unable to assess. Normal fills 2+.
differences.why: PRD main 414; focused-exam inventory default 1, 23, 28; forms 4.3

differences.what: Trace is not a pulse grade: the one pulse scale has none. Trace stays an option of Edema (line 35).
Absent is not typed: 0 is the grade of an absent pulse.

Edema is choose-one, a grade: None (the normal option), Trace, 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+. The codes one_plus, two_plus, three_plus and four_plus are given, as in the shared scales: the rule makes no code that starts with a letter from these labels.
Edema location is choose-many with the five options as written, and shows only while Edema is Trace or a grade, not None.
JVD is choose-one. None is the normal option; Unable to assess is neither normal nor abnormal.
